context: A karaoke room on Sakura's sixteenth birthday. Riku and Ren (her older cousin's tutor, here as her friend) are in the room. It's her first karaoke ever.
purpose: three-speaker birthday — teen self-consciousness meets older-kid encouragement

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Slumps back in the booth. Mix of Kansai drawl and Tokyo clip. Half-laugh, half-genuine resistance. Throws hands up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: なんで無理。誕生日やで。
lines.style: Casual older-brother energy. Borrows the Kansai lilt for emphasis — mild tease underneath. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当に、最初の一曲が、いちばん怖い。
lines.en: The first song is always the scariest part.
lines.style: Quiet, gentle observation — the kind of honest thing that lands because he's not trying. Soft voice, steady pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Half-pleading, half-commanding — a small negotiation. Voice hopeful but testing. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 私、本当に下手だから。逆効果。
lines.en: I'm really bad at singing — it'd only make things worse.
lines.style: A genuine self-deprecating laugh, unforced. Self-aware but not bitter. Shakes his head slightly, voice warm underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: I queued one up. Sing it with me?
lines.style: Small unexpected offer — softer than his earlier tone. A quiet gesture that costs him something. Voice gentle, no performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: A small honest condition. Voice rises slightly with relief. Pause before speaking — she's deciding to trust this. Quieter register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。私、見守る、本当に。
lines.en: Sounds good. I'll just watch from here.
lines.style: A graceful step back. Settles into the booth corner. Voice warm, settling. No awkwardness — this is the gift he's giving.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A small rally cry blended with Kansai flavor. Grabs the mic. Voice steady and ready. Gathers the room's energy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: A real half-laugh breaking through. Mic held slightly away from her face. Voice tight at first, then loosening. Breathing visible.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大丈夫。今日、いちばん安全な場所だよ、ここ。
lines.en: You're safe here. Today — this is the safest place for you.
lines.style: A small, honest sentence that settles. Voice warm and grounded. Not rushing. Lets the words land fully before finishing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A small countdown. Voice holds the whole room. No rush. Lets each number carry weight. Mic steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …(starts to sing, voice tiny then bigger)
lines.en: (voice small at first, then opening up as the song begins)
lines.style: A real moment of vulnerability. Voice cracks slightly on the first note, then settles and grows. Breathing audible. Genuine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当にいいよ、それ！時間、止まりそう。
lines.en: That was beautiful! Like time just stopped.
lines.style: Real encouragement without performance. Voice warm and steady. The words come easy because he means them. Soft clap underneath.
